definitions.explanation: The board game of chess, played between two players on a checkered board with 16 pieces each.

examples.japanese: {友達|ともだち}とオンラインでチェスをした。
examples.english: I played chess online with a friend.

examples.japanese: チェスは{将棋|しょうぎ}と{似|に}ているが、{取|と}った{駒|こま}を{使|つか}えない{点|てん}が{違|ちが}う。
examples.english: Chess is similar to shogi, but differs in that captured pieces cannot be reused.

notes:
USAGE:
The verb used with チェス is {指|さ}す (the same verb used for {将棋|しょうぎ}), though チェスをする and チェスをやる are also common.

Chess is less popular than {将棋|しょうぎ} in Japan, but has a dedicated following. {将棋|しょうぎ} is the Japanese equivalent board game.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- チェスを{指|さ}す: to play chess
- チェス{盤|ばん}: chessboard
- チェスの{駒|こま}: chess pieces
- チェスの{大会|たいかい}: chess tournament
